description:
An agentic IDE that helps you do your best work with features such as specs, steering, and hooks.

Kiro is an agentic IDE that helps you go from prototype to production with spec-driven development. From simple to complex tasks, Kiro works alongside you to turn prompts into detailed specs, then into working code, docs, and tests—so what you build is exactly what you want and ready to share with your team. Kiro's agents help you solve challenging problems and automate tasks like generating documentation and unit tests. With Kiro, you can build beyond prototypes while being in the driver's seat every step of the way.
Local Command Sandbox, Start Saved Workflows from Chat, and Live Tab Status
Limit what agent-run shell commands can reach, start saved Workflows from chat, and see live session status on editor tabs.
This release lets you limit what agent-run shell commands can reach and start saved Workflows from chat. It also shows live session status on editor tabs, explains model fallbacks, loads MCP tools on demand, and fixes Workflow, chat, and account issues.
Contain agent-run shell commands in a sandbox
Turn on the local command sandbox to limit what agent-run shell commands and their child processes can access. Choose whether outbound network access is blocked, limited to common development hosts, or open. You can also run local stdio MCP servers inside the same sandbox.
The agent, built-in file tools, and remote MCP servers stay outside the sandbox. Permission rules still govern agent actions. The sandbox reduces risk but cannot guarantee complete isolation, so keep reviewing proposed commands. Select Command sandbox in the status bar to open the settings and confirm the sandbox is active. Learn more ->
Start saved Workflows from chat
Type /workflow-run, choose a recipe, complete its inputs, and start the run. Kiro opens Workflows on the new run. Learn more ->
